title: AI Brand Mention Check input

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Required. The brand or product name to look for in the answers, 2 to 80 characters, for example Asana.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Optional. The brand's website, for example asana.com. A scheme, www. and any path are removed. It helps to tell the brand from an everyday word and to check cited URLs.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Optional. Other spellings of the brand, up to 5, each 2 to 80 characters, for example Mail Chimp for Mailchimp. Matched like the brand name.

category.title: Category
category.description: What the brand sells, 3 to 80 characters, for example project management software. Needed unless you give your own questions in Questions.

prompts.title: Questions
prompts.description: Optional. Your own questions (up to 20, each 8 to 300 characters). When given, they are used instead of the generated ones and the question count is ignored.

promptCount.title: Number of questions
promptCount.description: How many generated buyer-style questions to ask, from 1 to 8. Ignored when you give your own questions. Each question is asked of every engine.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional. City and country, for example Austin, US. Generated questions then ask for that place, and ChatGPT and Claude receive it as the approximate search location.

engines.title: Engines
engines.description: Which AI engines to ask: chatgpt, gemini, claude. Choose at least one. Default: all three. Each question and engine gives one result row.

includeAnswerText.title: Include answer text
includeAnswerText.description: Put the full answer of the engine in each result row (the answerText field). Turn it off for smaller exports. Default: on.

description: Enter your brand, its website and what it sells, then click Start. The Actor asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude buyer-style questions with web search on and tells you where the brand is named. It is a sample on small, low-cost models, not a view of the consumer apps.
